up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all unique molecules associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5550082'. Filter the docs table by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5550082'. Join to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno to get chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, and molecule_type. Left join to compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Return exactly these columns: chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Ensure each molecule appears only once in the results.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5550082'
